primitives.name: Video Ingestion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Stages S0–S3 (ingest, shot segmentation, detection, tracking) are the new video front-end that feeds V3.
primitives.assumptions: Input video is encoded with standard codecs; frame rate is known or derivable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Invalid or corrupted video streams cause early-stage failure.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw video bytes to temporal sequence of frames with metadata.
layer2.telemetry: Source FPS, resolution, duration recorded in manifest.

primitives.name: Shot Segmentation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Shots are the unit of tracking.** Tracker state resets on every camera cut.
primitives.assumptions: Camera cuts are detectable via hard transitions; shot boundaries are discrete events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Short shots (<30 frames) are merged into adjacent shots with QC flag.

layer2.mapping: Identifies temporal segments bounded by camera cuts for independent processing.
layer2.telemetry: List of Shot objects with start/end indices and QC flags.

primitives.name: Player Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Detector is an interface, not an implementation.** `detect(frame) -> sv.Detections`.
primitives.assumptions: Detection model outputs consistent format; interface is stable across implementations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failed detection results in empty or invalid Detections object.

layer2.mapping: Applies swappable detection algorithm to extract player bounding boxes per frame.
layer2.telemetry: Detections object containing box coordinates and tracker IDs.

primitives.name: Field Registration
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The math is the contract.** Homography estimation, projection, and kinematics are pure functions with exact I/O (§3).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_shot': '3x3 float64 matrix (pixel → field-yards)', 'H_frame': '3x3 float64 matrix (per-frame refined)', 'reprojection_error_px': 'pixels'}
primitives.assumptions: Field template is accurate and fixed; landmarks are identifiable in each frame.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Homography estimation fails when fewer than required landmarks are detected.

layer2.mapping: Estimates geometric transformation from image pixels to real-world field coordinates.
layer2.telemetry: Base homography matrix and reprojection error metrics.

reasoning_traces.think:
The pipeline operates in a layered fashion where ingestion provides temporal structure, shot segmentation isolates camera cuts for reset logic, detection identifies players, and field registration maps pixels to field space. Each stage must maintain deterministic behavior and strict I/O contracts. Failure gates ensure robustness: shot segments shorter than 30 frames are merged, detections without valid IDs are filtered, and homography estimation uses Kalman filtering for stability. The system enforces a clean separation between detector implementation and mathematical core (V3), ensuring modularity and reproducibility. All stages are designed to fail loudly with QC flags rather than degrade silently.
